thread:
tanya-peopleops: @kevin-eng quick q — planning to apply for Georgia 'Remotely from Georgia' visa, aiming for ~90–120 days starting 2026-06-05. Do I need to formally change my homebase? Will the WFH stipend cover internet only or can I ship my desk chair and monitor? :thinking:
kevin-eng: Heads up — for stays >30 days we ask folks to declare a temporary homebase so payroll/legal can assess tax nexus. Definitely loop in @lina-payroll for the stipend/ship stuff.
lina-payroll: Short answer: please declare. Monthly WFH stipend still applies while approved, but one-time equipment shipments are generally considered a taxable benefit in many jurisdictions and may require gross-up. We need invoice + manager approval if the company is paying/shipping. Also flag if you anticipate crossing 183 days — that can create tax residency.
tanya-peopleops: Thanks. What's the exact process and what docs do you need?
paul-legal: Quick legal note — Georgia's remote visa is straightforward but doesn't negate local tax obligations if days threshold met. We don't expect a PE from a single employee, but payroll/tax filings could still be required depending on duration and local rules. Share exact dates, address, and if any client-facing work will be done locally.
lina-payroll: Please complete the internal homebase-change form and upload these items. Required fields / docs (example):
```
- country: Georgia (GE)
- city: Tbilisi (if that's where you'll be)
- start_date: 2026-06-05
- expected_end_date: 2026-09-05
- manager_approval_screenshot or email
- shipping_invoice (if requesting company-paid shipment)
- passport page + visa (when available)
```
tanya-peopleops: Filing the form now. Manager already gave verbal okay; I'll attach the confirmation email. One more: is the monthly WFH stipend prorated if I'm only there for part of a payroll month?
lina-payroll: Yes — stipend is prorated to days approved in the payroll month. If we approve company-paid shipping, that will hit payroll as code SHIP-GE-01 and we will estimate withholding/gross-up. Expect an estimate email from the payroll system for the one-time tax impact.
hr-bot: Request GH-4821 created for tanya-peopleops. Tasks: payroll review, legal review, equipment tax calc. ETA: 2–3 business days.
tanya-peopleops: Great — thanks everyone. I'll attach docs and ping when passport/visa are in hand. :thumbsup:
